name: Qi An Xin Technology Group Inc.
summary: Qi An Xin Technology Group Inc., a cybersecurity company, provides cybersecurity products and services for government and enterprises in China and internationally. The company provides security operations and response, threat intelligence, network and perimeter security, endpoint and identity security, and forensics products. It also operates a security operations center that provides threat detection, data acquisition, analysis, real-time coordination and response, achieving early perception, and awareness of potential threats. Qi An Xin Technology Group Inc. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
